verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and HSM appliances (FIDO2, OpenPGP card, PIV, OTP, NetHSM) that hold keys on the device, not a data-collecting service. Whether user data is used to train AI models is not a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey collecting user content or offering AI features that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
